definitions.product_present: a subject's own REQUIRED input file of a given product type (not optional inputs, not software-bundled templates, not in-memory arrays)
definitions.attr_in: one input's attribute must take one of the given values (species, space, ...)
definitions.attr_equal: several inputs must share attribute values (subject, hemisphere, mesh, space, voxel_size)
definitions.label_policy: labels that must be excluded from an annotation (unknown, medial wall)
definitions.cardinality: a minimum number of subjects or subjects per group
definitions.design_variable: columns that must exist in the participants/design table
definitions.software: an executable program or toolbox that must be installed
definitions.provenance: a processing step that must have been completed before
definitions.scale_check: values must be converted with a verified scale factor
definitions.plausibility: values must lie within a numeric reference range
definitions.asymmetry_flip: left-right asymmetry requires a flip or symmetric-template check
definitions.advisory: anything else: visual inspection, recommendations, interpretation caveats, command-line usage, version notes, optional features, or what the method itself does

rules: 一条陈述只标一个主要条件
product_present：被试自己的、必需的输入文件；文档写明可选的、软件自带的资源、内存数据结构都不算
attr_in：对单个文件属性取值的要求（物种、空间等）
attr_equal：多个文件之间必须一致的属性（被试、半球、网格、空间、体素大小）
software：必需的可执行程序或工具箱
provenance：要求某个处理步骤已经完成
advisory：目视检查、操作建议、结果解释注意事项、命令行用法、版本说明、方法自身的处理描述
陈述超出引文内容的，按建议性处理并标注
unknown_scope: If a condition cannot be expressed without invented data or parameters, annotate advisory and explain. Preserve ambiguity for human decision.
